description: Search Revamp Vacations' published listings in Armenia: places to stay, tours, experiences, restaurants (eat) and places to visit. Returns each match's slug, type, location, headline price in AMD, short description, page link, and the listing's own cover photo (image) — use that photo when showing the result. For an exact all-in price and availability on dates, use get_quote.

cuisine.description: For restaurants: a cuisine/venue type, e.g. 'Armenian', 'Fast food'.

query.description: Free-text match on title, description, tags, cuisine, city.
